_documentation.model_purpose: Empirical D1×D2×D3 signal discrimination rules for the 11 METAR stations
_documentation.source: Timing store cross-analysis, population: SP500 daily bars 2011-2026
_documentation.methodology: SGS = (HR_zz75 - HR_zz25) / HR_zz25; Canary = HR(t-1) - HR(ENTRE)

signal_classes.PULLBACK: HR_zz25 > 55% but HR_zz75 < 55% — tactical bounce only
signal_classes.CANARY_ANTICIPATION: t-1 edge > 15pp with n >= 5 — signal before pivot
signal_classes.NOISE: No meaningful signal at any scale

confidence_tiers.INSUFFICIENT: Not enough data or weak signal
